<?php

namespace Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Concerns;

/**
 * @mixin \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model
 */
trait HasUuids
{
    /**
     * Initialize the trait.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public function initializeHasUuids()
    {
        $this->markModelAsUsingUniqueIdentifiers();
    }

    /**
     * Get the columns that should receive a unique identifier.
     *
     * @return array
     */
    public function uniqueIds()
    {
        return [$this->getKeyName()];
    }

    /**
     * Generate a new UUID for the model.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public function newUniqueId()
    {
        return $this->makeOrderedUuidIdentifier();
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve the model for a bound value.
     *
     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model|\Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\Relation  $query
     * @param  mixed  $value
     * @param  string|null  $field
     * @return \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\Relation
     *
     * @throws \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\ModelNotFoundException
     */
    public function resolveRouteBindingQuery($query, $value, $field = null)
    {
        return $this->resolveUuidRouteBindingQuery($query, $value, $field);
    }

    /**
     * Get the auto-incrementing key type.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public function getKeyType()
    {
        return $this->keyTypeForUuidIdentifiers();
    }

    /**
     * Get the value indicating whether the IDs are incrementing.
     *
     * @return bool
     */
    public function getIncrementing()
    {
        return $this->incrementingForUuidIdentifiers();
    }
}

Updated `Model::replicate()` to exclude all columns returned by `uniqueIds()` in addition to the primary key and timestamps. This prevents `HasUuids`/`HasUlids` non-primary unique columns from being carried over into replicas.

All 168 tests in `tests/Database/DatabaseEloquentModelTest.php` pass, including the non-primary UUID/ULID replication cases.
